method: web.run retrieved primary researcher pages; bounded paraphrase of inspected sections, not a native binary function implementation

sources.title: Hitstun, Smash SPECIAL research wiki
inspected_sections: Virtual hitstun versus accelerated actual duration
facts: Virtual ordinary hitstun is INT(KB*0.4)-1; actual duration can be shorter under Ultimate damage speed-up.
Additional hitstun cannot independently change an attack into tumble.

sources.title: Armor, Smash SPECIAL research wiki
facts: DK lifting while holding is listed with 80KB armor.
Armor accepts damage and hitlag while resisting launch; grabs and wind are distinct.
General heavy-armor threshold prose describes inclusive equality; the retained DK native strict reaction comparison is more specific and must control its exact boundary.

limits: Research pages do not expose DamageTransactorImpl::calc_reaction_frame implementation or reaction_max_ producer.
Research page patch dating, workbook13.0.1 and engine13.0.4 remain separate provenance.
